title: Nutty Moroccan Fish Sellou
description: A light and fluffy Moroccan dish featuring fish sauce and sous-vide cooked fish, suitable for flexitarian diets. Serve warm with a sprinkle of toasted almonds.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Place the cod fillets in a sous-vide machine at 120°F (49°C) for 30 minutes.
While the fish is cooking, toast the almonds in a pan over low heat, stirring frequently.
Combine the fish sauce, water, and a pinch of salt in a saucepan, and heat over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Once the fish is cooked, remove it from the sous-vide machine and place it on a plate.
Drizzle the fish sauce mixture over the fish.
Sprinkle the toasted almonds over the top of the fish.
Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
Note: Traditionally, sellou dishes are served with a sweet sauce, but this recipe omits that for a savory flavor.
Note: Adjust the amount of fish sauce to taste.
